entities.summary: Brigitte Lacombe is an American photographer based in New York City. In May 2009, she published a collection "Lacombe anima/persona" with her photographs covering her work from 1975 to 2008. Her work has been published in many magazines, including Vanity Fair, Glamour, The New Yorker, GQ, New York and The New York Times Magazine.
